description: This file defines a singly linked list data structure with operations to add, remove, retrieve size, and access elements by index. It includes an internal Node class and utility methods for list manipulation.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation managing nodes with string data, supporting typical list operations such as add, remove, size, and get by index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list, returning true if successful.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index in the list.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Helper method that unlinks a node from the list during removal.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Utility method to find the last node of the list given its head.
